lines.en: I hop along on my two hind legs
My tail balances me in the air
My forepaws tuck against my chest
I hop once and pause

lines.zh: 我的口鼻很长，鼻子一直动
lines.en: My snout is long and my nose keeps twitching
I pass through the low brush
I land with almost no sound
I run along a fallen log
Hopping is faster than walking for me
I turn a corner between grass blades

lines.zh: 我从这块石头蹦到那块
lines.en: I hop from this stone to that one

lines.zh: 我的后腿折起来再弹开
lines.en: My hind legs fold and spring
I hop lightly over the fallen leaves
One hop carries me over the root
My nose stays close to the ground
I run along the edge of the bushes

lines.zh: 我停下来抖了一下耳朵
lines.en: I stop and shake one ear

lines.zh: 我蹦到倒木上再跳下去
lines.en: I hop onto the log and leap off
I stand up to listen far off

lines.zh: 我的前爪抱着自己的胸口
lines.en: My forepaws hug my own chest
My nose keeps sniffing
I crouch with my tail behind me
I am watching an insect's wing
One of my ears flicked round
I wait for movement in the grass
My eyes are black and bright
I make myself very small
I tuck my hind legs under me
I sit, my nose still twitching
I look up at fruit high above
I hear an insect crawling on the ground
I shelter under a leaf

lines.zh: 我的尾巴慢慢摆了一下
lines.en: My tail sways once
Your shadow fell on my head
I hopped one step away

lines.zh: 你太高了，我看不清你的脸
lines.en: You are too tall, I cannot see your face
I do not know ones as big as you

lines.zh: 我的后腿已经准备好了
lines.en: My hind legs are ready
Have you come to catch me
I stop and watch you

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有别的味道
lines.en: I smell something else on you
I am in the grass, you are outside
One jump and I am gone
You crouched, that is better
I was knocked over
My hind legs are numb
My hind legs will not spring
I shiver in the grass
A wound this small is enough for me
I struggle to right myself
My tail bent
My breath comes short and fast
I slowly crawl back to the grass
I have not the strength yet to run
What small thing is that

lines.zh: 你手里有一点能吃的东西
lines.en: There is something edible in your hand
I smell it, very fragrant
This is enough for a bite
I need to come a little closer
Keep your hand lower
This scent is new to me
I hopped a full circle round it
This smells sweet
I raised my forepaws
Could you lower it a bit more
I only take small bites

lines.zh: 这比你站着的时候好多了
lines.en: This is much better than when you stand
I am already two steps from you
You touched my tail
I sprang two blocks away
We bumped, and I am small
I slip away along the ground

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我心跳很快
lines.en: That bumped my heart rate up
I glance back at you once
I retreat into the grass

lines.zh: 我们不常碰到这么大的东西
lines.en: We rarely meet something this big

lines.zh: 我们在同一个季节里出现
lines.en: We appear in the same season

lines.zh: 我的伴侣会一起蹦着走
lines.en: My mate and I hop along together
This has nothing to do with outside things
We mind our own business
I do not discuss such things
We keep moving on
I hop once and turn away
I am done minding you
I pick up a small fruit
I can crack this open
I hold it in my forepaws and eat

lines.zh: 地上掉的东西都值得看看
lines.en: Anything on the ground is worth a look
My nose touches it once
This thing is too hard
I hide it under the grass
This will occupy my teeth a while
I hop away with it in my mouth
I raise my head at that direction
My nose knew first
Should I go and look
That direction is not far
I hop twice and stop
I have fixed on that sound
It has not seen me
I am ready to bolt
I edge in bit by bit
I watch it between the blades
I retreat behind the fallen log
I do not dare get too close

lines.zh: 我两条后腿，跑起来像跳。
lines.en: On two hind legs, I run in bounds.
I keep my tail low
I will wait a little longer
If it moves, I run first
I kick with my hind legs
There is only a little force in it
I bump and spring away
I bite at its edge
I push with my forepaws
I only wanted it to move aside
I am already at a safe distance
I kick it with my hind legs
My teeth are small but quick

lines.zh: 我从德国始新世的林子里出来
lines.en: I come out of an Eocene German wood

lines.zh: 我是这里最小的双足行者
lines.en: I am the smallest two-legged walker here
My tail is longer than my body
I hop once and look around
This place has insects and fruit

lines.zh: 我不像啮齿类，我很特别
lines.en: I am not a rodent, I am something else
I hide myself in the grass
The ground here is soft
I hop away

lines.zh: 我从始新世的落叶堆里蹦出来。
lines.en: I hop out of an Eocene heap of fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 这块地方我可以蹦一整天
lines.en: I could hop here all day

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的毛就焦了
lines.en: The fire came near and my fur singed
I hit the ground, hind legs first
Water came up to my nose
The blast threw me clean off my feet

lines.zh: 一根细东西扎进我的侧面
lines.en: Something thin stuck in my side

lines.zh: 那股术力让我四肢发麻
lines.en: That magic numbed my limbs
I have not found fruit yet
The flash turned all the grass white
The ground under me is simply gone
